abhacca.p: [Na+bhacca] (ti) CL=9 Should not be fed or should not be supported; a person who should not be fed or should not be supported;

abhacca：＂အဘစ္စ（တိ）
[န+ဘစ္စ]
မကျွေးမွေးအပ်-မထောက်ပံ့အပ်-သော၊ သူ။
DOP: bhacca mfn., m., and n. [ fpp of bharati; S. bhṛtya], 1. ( mfn. ) to be supported; Ja IV 301, 14* (~ā mātā pitā bandhū; 301, 18´ : mātā ca pitā ca sesabandhū ca bharitabbā nāma); — ifc see anna-; — 2. ( m. ) a dependant; a servant; a minister; Abh 514 (~o ca paricāriko, Be so; Ce kiṃkāro); A II 68, 30* (bhuttā bhogā bhatā ~ā); Ja V 343, 25* (mittāmaccā ca ~ā ca puttadārā ca bandhavā) ≠ VI 301, 22* (mittāmacce ca ~e ca, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee suhajje); Nidd-a I 251, 18 (ñātimittāmaccapalibodhan ti … amaccā ~ā, Be so; Ce, Ee amaccā amaccagaṇā; Se amaccā gumbā); Paṭis-a 486, 25 (mittā sahāyā amaccā ~ā); Mhv 7:17 (imāya khalu ~ā me gahitā nū ti); Sadd 622, 20 (co tassa: ~o bhatto vā); — abhacca , m ( fn )., (one) who is not to be supported, who is not a dependant; Ja II 370, 13* (annabhaccā c’ ~ā ca; 370, 20´ : abharitabbattā ~ā).
CPD: a-bhacca , m ( fn. ) [ 3 a + sa. bhṛtya], not being servant; m. pl. ~ā (anna-bhaccā +), Ja ll 370, 13 * (tathā (ɔ: annena) abharitabbattā ~ā, Ct. ).
